value.rationale: The exact integral wedge type and full rational symmetry action are distinct topological invariants of a canonical historically significant twelve-vertex cubic graph derived from Petersen by vertex surgery. The sign on the three other Kneser labels and splitting into even/odd eigendirections on the swapped pair distinguish symmetry effects not determined by homology ranks; it is an exact motivated classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
